lines.translation: Rest and joy, light for the Jews
A day of complete rest, a day of delights
Those who keep it and those who remember it, they testify
That in six [days] all were created and endure
The highest heavens, earth and seas
All the host on high, lofty and exalted
The sea monster and man, and the wild beasts
For in Yah, the LORD, is the Rock of the worlds
It is He who spoke to His treasured people
Keep it, to sanctify it, from its coming until its departure
The holy Sabbath, the day of His delight

lines.hebrew: כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת אֵל מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ.
lines.translation: For on it God rested from all His work
By the commandment of Shabbat, God will deliver you
Arise, call out to Him, He will hasten to strengthen you
[Say] "the soul of every living thing," and also "we will revere You"
Eat with joy, for He has already favored you
With double bread and the great Kiddush
With many delicacies and a generous spirit
Those who delight in it will merit great good
With the coming of the Redeemer, for the life of the World to Come
